scope: Static review only; no staging, graph, container, device or Bridge execution.

confirmed_fixes.authoritative_binding: load_environment(local_env.md) config SHA pinned 5ce3a58541ef1711890aad8348c3a31a03203f584fa50f1f5c0cb4fd88b49718; all required NANHAI_* environment variables compared to parsed authoritative values; host required gz02 and project resolved from pinned binding.
confirmed_fixes.input_hashes: generator SHA256 dafbc416c2b036ea8816591f408b24a8a99974827302968041474d54ef550634 and ledger SHA256 fe22e645511647b6b34dd83f5c0573ef1f8d45eaf380ac08b12c5120d1e13356 pinned and matched current local files.
confirmed_fixes.remote_path: Remote program requires exact three names/order, project/control existing real directories, opens control with O_DIRECTORY|O_NOFOLLOW, and creates/reads only leaf names through dir_fd with O_NOFOLLOW and SHA/mode checks; no graph/device/container launcher.
confirmed_fixes.failure_receipt_attempt: Exceptions after entering try are caught and an exclusive hard-link installation of local receipt is attempted. Existing receipt is checked before SSH.

blockers.finding: Receipt status starts FAILED_PRE_STAGING and is not advanced before SSH. A timeout, nonzero SSH rc, or invalid success JSON can occur after remote files were created, yet the persisted failure receipt still claims pre-staging.
blockers.minimum_fix: Set status to REMOTE_STATE_UNKNOWN or STAGING_ATTEMPTED_RECONCILE immediately before subprocess.run; reserve FAILED_PRE_STAGING for failures before any remote attempt. Record whether remote invocation started and require read-only reconciliation before retry after unknown state.

blockers.finding: Two concurrent invocations can both pass RECEIPT.exists(), both contact gz02 and only then contend on os.link. The receipt is protected against overwrite, but remote staging is not one-shot reserved.
blockers.minimum_fix: Acquire an O_EXCL file or atomic mkdir lock before SSH; a loser must not contact gz02. Preserve a failure/unknown-state receipt or reservation for a crashed or interrupted winner, then release only under explicit reconciliation policy.

limits: A successful local receipt validates remote reported file names and SHA, while the remote program itself verifies content and read-only permission bits; this review does not test execution.

Directory-fd binding protects against leaf symlink escape, but external rename of the opened directory is outside the observed static guarantee; retain project directory ownership and pre/post checks.
